Initialize static appearance features using the spherical harmonics DC coefficients trained up to iteration 15,000.

The simplification step at 20,000 iterations adds computational overhead for LD scoring.

SVQ reduces memory and potentially speeds up rendering.
The method requires careful tuning of iteration milestones.
The approach is designed to optimize the trade-off between training time, memory usage, and rendering quality.
